evidence_class.name: LINEAGE_LOCAL_PREOUTCOME_HISTORICAL_PREDICTIVE_EVALUATION_NOT_GLOBAL_UNTOUCHED_HOLDOUT
evidence_class.meaning: Predictions were frozen before this SW0 lineage accessed outcomes, but DEV2000 A/B has historical exposure elsewhere in the wider project. Results must not be described as a globally untouched holdout.

outcome_source_contract.rule: No outcome file may be opened until a separate Owner Gate binds an exact result-only source identity/hash and authorizes evaluation.

primary_metric.name: mean_exact_ordered_top3_log_loss
primary_metric.uniform_baseline: -mean(log(1/(n*(n-1)*(n-2)))) using each race field size n
primary_metric.effect: uniform_log_loss - sw0_log_loss; positive means SW0 improves over uniform

predefined_classification.STRONG_PREDICTIVE_SIGNAL: pooled primary effect > 0; 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0; A effect > 0; B effect > 0; winner Brier improvement > 0
predefined_classification.POSITIVE_BUT_UNCERTAIN: pooled primary effect > 0 but STRONG conditions not all met

no_posthoc_actions: No parameter/model selection or calibration from revealed outcomes under this gate
No rerun with altered thresholds/metrics after outcomes
No model promotion regardless of verdict
next_owner_gate_scope_proposed: Authorize one read/evaluation of an exact hash-bound result-only A+B outcome source against the already-frozen SW0 prediction lock under this preregistration; no payout/odds/economics, tuning, promotion, C, holdout, Runtime or betting.
